scope: Proposition 4.3 (Routing and good parameters) of the manuscript “Strong diffeomorphic approximation in three dimensions for p>2” (preprints/Strong-diffeomorphic-approximation-in-three-dimensions-for-p-gt-2-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 368 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 824a96588feb42d5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 57. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every pre-stack root j, outside a null subset of (0, wj), the diagonal rule constructs a connected, oriented, properly embedded surface Lj,λ whose boundary, with coorientation, is the prescribed boundary of the original j-level at parameter λ. Different constructed surfaces are disjoint except for the prescribed essential arc intersections between opposite-colour roots. Each such surface is obtained by attaching punctured disks and annuli along a rooted tree; it may have ends at infinity. The following stronger local finiteness holds for each constructed surface: for every compact K ⊂ Mx, only finitely many of its reached states have an original parent collar meeting K.
